warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0067; not an independent human or learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: The authored find sentences are short and interpretable as encountering/coming upon a familiar person in a place.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: برخوردن یا پیدا کردن keeps the selected encounter/find sense explicit.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The person stays constant while location changes, isolating the target verb.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast find with unrelated targets and the first/second responses.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A community-center arrival gives a concrete reason to mention encountering Iris.

difficultyFit.evidence: Sentence structure is simple; semantic nuance is kept bounded by the scene.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: find repeats with two familiar locations.

transferQuality.evidence: Final retrieval changes location while preserving the selected sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scene, encounter sense and activities are aligned within a deliberately narrow boundary.

learnerExperience.evidence: Model/editor review only; no learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
find has multiple common senses; only the committed encounter/come-upon sense is intended here.
Audio prosody is not reviewed before text gates pass.
resolvedFindings: The Lesson does not claim mastery of all senses of find.
